# 0057 R03 Independent Semantic Review — Final Verdict (exact-SHA read-only)

**candidate_sha256**: `8f3b404cad787975d06444603ca647702afc7f21df1d526d3ea2daeb800effb4` — **reconfirmed identical** to the value hashed before reading; all conclusions below bind to those exact bytes only.

**Scope**: Blueprint `0057_UNIQUE_BLUEPRINT_R03.md` only (under 0057→I13-E01→official checkbox 061, genre analysis_report). Read-only semantic review. **This is not DOCX technical/layout/visual acceptance, not formal acceptance, and no association fact is claimed.**

## Verdict: **PARTIAL**

## PASS/PARTIAL/FAIL by review area

| Area | Verdict |
|---|---|
| 1. SHA binding / identity | **PASS** — candidate SHA matches; `0057`/`I13-E01`/`061` are kept as three distinct fields (§1, SF-0057-203); analysis_report genre corroborated by source packet §1 and 03_157 I13 row 153; current official requirement confirmed verbatim from official excerpt (061 = 「相關文件紀錄能證實近年來對訓練成果轉移及達成的檢討，並有具體佐證資料。」); historical 142 crosswalk is correctly declared non-current, candidate mapping only; not formal acceptance. |
| 2. Title-blind central identification / neighbors | **PASS** — hiding the title/filename, the central T1/T2/T3/T4/T5 tables, findings and decision logic still identify a concrete multi-period (2024/2025/2026Q1) training-transfer + attainment review. Distinct from 062 (T12 is a single 061-action element, no team/org performance content) and 063 (mechanisms only referenced as possible evidence, no mechanism-operation report). Negative neighbors 0055/0056/0058/0059 themes do not fit. |
| 3. Usability & maturity | **PASS** — complete cohort definitions (A–G), T+90 primary wave, six rates with numerator/denominator/units, questionnaire Q1–Q6 with scales/scoring, observation rubric R1–R4 (0–3, ≥9/12), nonresponse/N/A/not-yet-due rules, full synthetic case with T+180 descriptive, full SMART plan, findings/limitations/decision rules/tracker, HOLD criteria. |
| 4. Independent recomputation T2/T4/T5/T6 | **PASS** — all recomputed by hand: T2 six rates ×4 rows all match (e.g. 29/36 = 0.8055…→80.6%; 10/17 = 0.5882→58.8%; 93/109 = 0.8532→85.3%); merges use summed numerators/denominators (40+48+30=118; 36+45+28=109; 32+40+25=97; 24+32+18=74; 15+22+11=48; 29+39+25=93; 6+10+5=21); nesting G≤E≤D≤C≤A and F≤B≤A holds per cohort; T4 exclusivity holds (4+2+9=15; 6+4+12=22; 3+2+6=11; G=Tier-A+Tier-B 6/10/5; merged 13+8+27=48, G=21, record-count column 9+15+7=31 kept separate from persons); T5 group sums equal D and E per period and merged (33+41=74; 26+22=48), P3 gap 75.0−50.0=25.0 pp; T6: 失聯+拒訪 = C−D per period (5+3=8; 4+4=8; 5+2=7) and merged (14+9=23); DEC-A…E revalidated — only P3 inputs used (B: 61.1%<70% ∧ 45.5%<50% triggers; C: 72.0%<75%; D: 25.0≥15; A/E not triggered), merged rates labeled descriptive/non-decision. |
| 5. T+90 / T+180 date recomputation | **PASS** — confirmed: 14 P3-Q2 completion dates explicitly dated 2026-04-02…06-26 (14 values enumerated in §5.1/SF-0057-030…043), none on 2026-04-01 (SF-0057-008 window start ≠ any completion date); earliest T+90 = 2026-07-01 (2026-04-02+90) > cutoff 2026-06-30 → all 14 excluded from every rate under the declared policy; latest T+90 = 2026-09-24 (2026-06-26+90); P3 latest T+90 = 2026-06-29 (2026-03-31+90) ≤ cutoff → mature; P1 2025-03-31, P2 2026-03-31; P2 T+180 = 2026-06-29; P3 T+180 = 2026-09-27 = NOT YET DUE; P3-Q2 T+180 = 2026-12-23; case T+30/+60/+90/+180 = 2025-04-14/05-14/06-13/09-11 all arithmetic-consistent. |
| 6. Register atomicity & coverage | **PARTIAL (defect-blocking)** — details below. |
| 7. SAMPLE/REAL boundaries | **PASS** — all facts SYNTHETIC/PENDING_REAL_SOURCE; no fabricated approvals, signatures, staff names, third-party documents or outcomes; decisions/tracker states all 「預擬／未核定」, owners all PROPOSED; safe body instructions (ID layering §5.7, 10.5/9.5 pt, no control keys in body); no causal or TTQS-score claims. No real-evidence-boundary defect. |

The register-atomicity defect per the prompt prevents **PASS**; all defects are bounded and repairable, no fabrication or calculation error → **PARTIAL**, not FAIL.

## Actionable issues (fact_id + locator + minimum repair)

### A. Register atomicity — rows whose value cell bundles multiple distinct synthetic values (violates §13.2 「一列一值」)

| fact_id | Locator | Defect | Minimum repair |
|---|---|---|---|
| SF-0057-184 | T7 / T+30 列／產出欄；§12.1 佐證（乙）；§12.2 追蹤結果 T+30 列 | Bundles 3 questionnaire answers (Q1=2, Q2=4, Q3=5) in one row | Split into 3 rows (SF-0057-184a/b/c), one answer each, each with the three display locators |
| SF-0057-186 | T7 / T+60 列／產出欄；§12.1 佐證（丙）；§12.2 追蹤結果 T+60 列 | Bundles 4 rubric scores (R1=3, R2=2, R3=3, R4=2) plus subtotal | Split into 4 per-item rows + keep subtotal as its own row (or add 10/12 to SF-0057-152's locator) |
| SF-0057-188 | T7 / T+90 列／產出欄；§12.1 佐證（丁） | Bundles record count (3 筆) and referral-trigger content (其中 1 筆觸發界線) | Split count row from referral-flag row |
| SF-0057-191 | §12.2 ／期限列 | Bundles two distinct dates (首次 2025-04-15；持續至 2025-06-13) | Two rows, one date each |
| SF-0057-192 | §12.2 ／學習能力列 | Bundles two competencies (C2；C3) | Two rows (or reference T3 capability items) |
| SF-0057-194 | §12.2 ／頻率列 | Bundles frequency rule (24 小時內) and class count (每月 2 班) | Two rows |
| SF-0057-195 | §12.2 ／擬議支持列 | Bundles two support mechanisms (例會抽查；界線判準卡) | Two rows |
| SF-0057-198 | §12.2 ／阻礙列 | Bundles 3 barriers (時間不足；18 欄；缺乏即時回饋) — exactly the prompt's multi-questionnaire-answer bundle pattern | Three rows; the 「18 欄」 value itself must have its own locator/fact row |
| SF-0057-199 | §12.2 ／證據定位列 | Bundles two evidence sets (紀錄抽查 3 筆＋觀察 10/12) | Two rows referencing SF-0057-188/186 splits |
| SF-0057-201 | §9 圖3 / 節點(1)～(6) | One fact row covers six distinct node texts of the flowchart | Six rows (節點 1–6), one node text each |

### B. Register coverage — displayed synthetic values with no fact row / unresolvable locator (「203 rows」 alone is not completeness)

| Item | Locator | Defect | Minimum repair |
|---|---|---|---|
| T8 群組欄 | T8 / P1–P3 列／陪伴組應用率、無陪伴組應用率欄 | Displayed values never locatored — SF-0057-115/118/121/124/127/130 locators list T5 and 圖2 but not T8 | Add T8 cell locators to those six existing rows (repeat-display rule allows same-row multi-locator) |
| T9 ／行動欄 | T9 / F1–F5 列／行動欄 | Five displayed synthetic action texts unregistered | Add 5 rows (or one row per distinct action) |
| T9 ／再追蹤指標欄 | T9 / F2、F4、F5、F1 列 | Only F3's metric is registered (via SF-0057-130); the other four are not | Add 4 rows |
| §11 重檢日期 | §11 補述（「2027 上半年重檢」） | Synthetic date displayed without fact row | Add one row |
| SF-0057-001 locator | T1 欄定義／「資料截點」列 | T1 data table has no 資料截點 column (schema only) — locator resolves to no displayed cell | Add the 資料截點 column to the T1 example table (value 2026-06-30 per row) or fix the locator |
| §13.1／§7 T3 欄不一致 | T3 欄定義 vs T3 資料表 | Schema lists 評量題數／各項滿分／達門檻標準; example table lacks 評量題數 and uses different column names — writer ambiguity risk | Harmonize schema and example columns (and add T8 column names一致) |

## Exact calculations/date checks performed
Listed in areas 4–5 above; all 48 T2 cells, T4/T5/T6 sums and exclusivity, all five DEC rules, and every T+90/T+180 maturity date recomputed independently and matched.

## Limitations
- Official PDF binary itself not read (not in the permitted five sources); page-4 verbatim text verified only through the permitted extraction (`official_full_text.txt` L400–402) plus source-packet readback; PDF SHA `805386…` and text-extract SHA `ac3895…`, crosswalk/blob SHAs were taken as declared, not independently recomputed here.
- Historical 142-registry readback has not been performed → the `0057→I13-E01→061` mapping stays a crosswalk-supported candidate mapping (HOLD clause §16.1 correctly self-declared); this blocks promotion, not this Blueprint review.
- Neighbor deliverables (0055/0056/0058/0059) were not read; negative-neighbor distinctness was judged from this candidate's boundary tables plus `03_157_CHECKBOX_BLUEPRINTS.md` rows 153–157.

**Bottom line**: identity, genre, title-blind identification, neighbor boundaries, all arithmetic, all maturity dates, and every SAMPLE/REAL truth boundary **PASS**; the atomic register has the 10 bundled-value rows (Section A) and 6 coverage/locator gaps (Section B), which are bounded, sidecar-only, content-preserving repairs → **PARTIAL**, repair to PASS before any promotion. No DOCX acceptance of any kind is claimed.
